items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn helper every element uses to merge class names.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: The whole aiellie stylesheet: color, type, radius, shadow and motion tokens. It replaces your app/globals.css.

items.name: models
items.title: Models
items.description: The model catalogue a selector is handed: the option shape, the vendor headings, the grouping, a list to start from, and the providers whose keys reach them.

items.name: editable-title
items.title: Editable Title
items.description: A heading you click to rename in place: Enter keeps the new name, Escape keeps the old one. Also exports the hook behind the field, for renaming anywhere else.

items.name: highlight-code
items.title: Highlight Code
items.description: Turns code into highlighted HTML with Shiki, in GitHub's light and dark themes.

items.name: file-search
items.title: File Search
items.description: Finds text in file names and contents, with match case, whole word and regex, and previews a replacement that can keep each match's case.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: The marks drawn here rather than looked up in an icon set: vendor marks keyed by vendor, language and file marks keyed by extension, and aiellie's own marks.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Base UI's button with this registry's variants and sizes on it.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A text field that grows with what is typed into it.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Base UI's tooltip with this registry's popup and arrow on it.
items.docs: The open and close animations come from tw-animate-css. Add `@import "tw-animate-css";` to your global stylesheet if it is not there already.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Base UI's popover as a glass panel that floats beside its trigger, for small forms and details.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Base UI's preview card as a glass panel that opens while its trigger is hovered or focused.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Base UI's dialog: a glass panel in the middle of the screen, over a dimmed page.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable list you move through with the keyboard, on its own or as a palette in a dialog.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Base UI's dialog as a panel that slides in from an edge of the screen, over a dimmed page.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels split by a line that can be dragged to resize them, with a grip that shows on hover.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: Use Mobile
items.description: A hook that reports whether the window is narrower than a tablet, for layouts that change shape on a phone.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Base UI's input at editor density, with focus shown as a change of border colour.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: An input with icons, text or buttons set inside its edge, sharing one border.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed until it's pressed again, filled while on.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A row of toggles where one or several can be on, set apart or joined into one control.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: An input that filters a list as you type and picks from it, on Base UI.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Base UI's separator: a hairline between groups, across or down.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A quiet line of text in a list or thread, on its own, under a rule, or between two rules.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A muted block that pulses where content is still loading.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Base UI's avatar: someone's picture, their initials while it loads or when there is none, and a badge or a group of them.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: shadcn's badge: a short label beside something, in six variants, rendered as whatever element you give it.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: shadcn's empty: what a place shows when there is nothing in it yet, with room for an icon, a title, a line of help and an action.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: shadcn's sidebar in this registry's style: a provider that keeps it open or folded, the rail itself, and the groups and rows that go in it. On a phone it opens as a sheet.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Base UI's tabs: a row of views to switch between, on a muted track.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: shadcn's breadcrumb: a compact path that shows where the current page sits in a hierarchy.

items.name: user-menu
items.title: User Menu
items.description: Who is signed in, at the foot of a sidebar: a small picture and their name, opening a menu headed by them and their plan, with usage, invites, settings and logging out.

items.name: help-menu
items.title: Help Menu
items.description: Where to go for help: a question-mark button with a tooltip, opening a menu of help, keyboard shortcuts, what's new and the privacy center.

items.name: panels
items.title: Panels
items.description: An app shell: the page in the middle, with resizable panels on the left, the right and along the bottom, toggled from their headers or with ⌘B, ⌘I and ⌘J. On a phone the side panels open as sheets.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Base UI's menu with this registry's surface on it, plus an optional search box that filters the rows.

items.name: settings-dialog
items.title: Settings Dialog
items.description: A wide, resizable settings window with persistent navigation on the left and the active account, appearance, model provider keys, or API keys section on the right.

items.name: share-dialog
items.title: Share Dialog
items.description: Sharing something by link: who can open it, the link to copy, a preview slot, and buttons to post it to X, LinkedIn or Reddit.

items.name: file-preview
items.title: File Preview
items.description: A file opened in a dialog: an image, a PDF, text or code highlighted by language, or the files in a folder, with a download button that zips a folder.

items.name: temporary-chat-toggle
items.title: Temporary Chat Toggle
items.description: An icon button that turns temporary chat on and off. It holds no state, so your app decides what a temporary chat leaves out.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Base UI's toolbar with this registry's surface on it, plus buttons that name themselves in a tooltip.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: A labelled state pill with an optional pulsing indicator.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A reading inside a known range, like a context window or a credit balance, with a label, a formatted value and a fill that can turn to a status tone.

items.name: tooltip-icon-button
items.title: Tooltip Icon Button
items.description: An icon button that carries its own tooltip and screen-reader label.

items.name: history-buttons
items.title: History Buttons
items.description: Back and forward buttons for stepping through what was opened, each with a tooltip naming its shortcut.

items.name: add-menu
items.title: Add Menu
items.description: A plus button with a tooltip that opens a menu of things to add, like files or photos.

items.name: waveform
items.title: Waveform
items.description: Live bars that follow an audio stream, newest on the right, so a microphone can be seen to hear you. They hold still under reduced motion.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Stacked and anchored notifications with actions, semantic status icons and swipe-to-dismiss behavior.

items.name: project-selector
items.title: Project Selector
items.description: Which project a chat belongs to: one button opens a searchable menu to switch it, and pressing the current project again removes it. Its rows also come alone, for a submenu of your own.

items.name: plugin-selector
items.title: Plugin Selector
items.description: A small button that shows which plugins a chat can use, with their marks and a count, and opens a menu to turn them on and off. Its rows also come alone, for a submenu of your own, and so do chips, one per plugin turned on, whose mark turns into a remove button on hover.

items.name: work-in-menu
items.title: Work In Menu
items.description: A small button that says where work runs, opening a menu of places: local, a new local copy, a worktree or the cloud, with an optional row to connect an account.

items.name: branches-menu
items.title: Branches Menu
items.description: A small button that shows the branch checked out, opening a searchable list of branches with a row pinned at the bottom that creates and checks out the branch typed into the search.

items.name: dictate-button
items.title: Dictate Button
items.description: A microphone button that types what you say into a field, using the browser's own speech recognition, and grows into a live waveform while it listens. It renders nothing where the browser has none.

items.name: model-selector
items.title: Model Selector
items.description: A simple model selector component

items.name: composer
items.title: Composer
items.description: The box a message is written in: a field that grows as you type, and a row beneath it for controls, like an add menu or a model selector, that ends in a send button that turns into stop while a reply streams.

items.name: attachments
items.title: Attachments
items.description: Files in a row that scrolls: an image as a small square of itself, anything else as a chip with its icon, name and details, each able to open and to be removed.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One turn in a conversation: a bubble or plain text in six variants, with an avatar, header, footer, timestamp, reactions, hover actions and a caret while the reply streams.
items.docs: The caret's blink comes from tw-animate-css. Add `@import "tw-animate-css";` to your global stylesheet if it is not there already.

items.name: date-divider
items.title: Date Divider
items.description: The day and time a thread picks up at, centred above its messages as plain text, like Yesterday at 5:16 PM.

items.name: stream-text
items.title: Stream Text
items.description: A streamed reply written out whole words at a time, at the rate the stream arrives, so bursts and pauses read as one steady cadence.
items.docs: The caret's blink comes from tw-animate-css. Newest words and the caret use the `--live` colour from @aiellie/theme, and fall back to the text colour without it.

items.name: thinking-indicator
items.title: Thinking Indicator
items.description: What a reply is doing before its first word: a pulsing live dot, a shimmering label like Thinking or Searching the web, and the seconds so far.
items.docs: The shimmer comes from shadcn/tailwind.css, which `shadcn init` adds to your global stylesheet.

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: What a model thought before replying: a row that reads Thinking and counts the seconds while it works, then Worked for 12s, folding open to show the thoughts.
items.docs: The shimmer on Thinking comes from shadcn/tailwind.css, which `shadcn init` adds to your global stylesheet.

items.name: sources
items.title: Sources
items.description: The pages a reply drew on: chips that show each site's favicon and name and open the page, with a hover card previewing its image, title and description, and the rest folded into a +N chip.
items.docs: Pass `loadPreview` to fill each hover card from the page itself. The `link-preview` item installs a route that does it: `(href) => fetch(`/api/link-preview?url=${encodeURIComponent(href)}`).then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))`.

items.name: link-preview
items.title: Link Preview
items.description: A route that reads a web page's title, description, image and icon from its head, for source previews. It only fetches public web addresses, checks every redirect, and gives up after five seconds.

items.name: suggestions
items.title: Suggestions
items.description: Prompts to start from: a row of small outline buttons that arrive together, one after another.

items.name: thread
items.title: Thread
items.description: The scrolling part of a conversation, on shadcn's message scroller. It anchors each new turn near the top, follows a streaming reply only while you are at the end, opens a saved chat at its last turn, and keeps your place when older messages load.
items.docs: The bottom fade comes from shadcn/tailwind.css. Add `@import "shadcn/tailwind.css";` to your global stylesheet if it is not there already.

items.name: nav-bars
items.title: Nav Bars
items.description: A rail of short bars for a page's sections or a thread's turns, marking what's in view. Hover for a list, a peek at one item, or a rail that expands into labels.

items.name: thread-transcript
items.title: Thread Transcript
items.description: Nav bars wired to a thread: one bar per turn, marking the turns in view and jumping to the one you pick.

items.name: quick-chat
items.title: Quick Chat
items.description: A compact conversation panel that floats at the bottom corner of the current page, keeping a quick question separate from the main thread.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A block of code named by its file, with copy and download in its header, highlighted by Shiki in light and dark, with line numbers, marked lines and a caret while it streams.
items.docs: Shiki loads the first time a block needs colour, so it stays out of pages that show no code. The caret's blink comes from tw-animate-css. Add `@import "tw-animate-css";` to your global stylesheet if it is not there already.

items.name: code-diff
items.title: Code Diff
items.description: What a change did, read from a unified diff: added and removed lines tinted and marked, both sides numbered, and a +N −M count for the header.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: A command and what came back: the prompt and the command highlighted as shell, its output, and a line that says whether it is running, done or failed.
items.docs: The shimmer comes from shadcn/tailwind.css, which `shadcn init` adds to your global stylesheet.

items.name: response
items.title: Response
items.description: A reply written in Markdown, set as prose: headings, lists, quotes, links, tables and inline code, with fenced code in a code block, and each word fading in while it streams.
items.docs: The caret's blink comes from tw-animate-css. Add `@import "tw-animate-css";` to your global stylesheet if it is not there already.

items.name: tool-call
items.title: Tool Call
items.description: A tool the model called, folded behind one row that names it and says whether it is queued, waiting on approval, running, done or failed, opening to show what went in and came out.
items.docs: The shimmer comes from shadcn/tailwind.css, which `shadcn init` adds to your global stylesheet.

items.name: message-actions
items.title: Message Actions
items.description: Ready-made controls for a message's footer: copy with a tick once copied, retry, edit, a thumbs up or down, and a menu for the rest.

items.name: inline-citation
items.title: Inline Citation
items.description: A numbered mark in a reply's prose that names the page it cites on hover and opens it on a click.

items.name: quoted-message
items.title: Quoted Message
items.description: The words a reply is about, kept to a short excerpt above it behind a rule on the start side, with who said them and a way to remove the quote.

items.name: message-highlight-toolbar
items.title: Message Highlight Toolbar
items.description: A small toolbar that floats over text selected in a thread, with actions that get the selected words, like quoting or explaining them.

items.name: effort-menu
items.title: Effort Menu
items.description: How hard the model thinks, set from the composer: a button showing the level, opening a slider of six named levels from Off to Max that match the AI SDK's reasoning option.

items.name: approval-mode-menu
items.title: Approval Mode Menu
items.description: How much an agent may do without asking, chosen from the composer: auto, manual, accept edits and plan, with full access set apart.

items.name: slash-menu
items.title: Slash Menu
items.description: The commands a slash opens at the start of the composer, filtered as you type and picked with the arrow keys and Enter.

items.name: mentions
items.title: Mentions
items.description: The people and agents an at sign opens in the composer, filtered as you type and put into the message as @Name.

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: A chat page: your chats in a sidebar, a thread that streams replies from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or the Vercel AI Gateway with your own key, showing what the model is doing, its thoughts and the pages it searched, and a composer with a model selector that sends images, PDFs, files and folders along.

items.name: orb
items.title: Orb
items.description: The assistant as a sphere of moving colour that idles, listens, thinks, speaks and sleeps, swelling with the voice. Any word gives it a look of its own.

items.name: transcript
items.title: Transcript
items.description: Speech as text: lines by speaker that follow the newest, with words still being guessed shimmering until they settle.
items.docs: The shimmer comes from shadcn/tailwind.css, which `shadcn init` adds to your global stylesheet.

items.name: audio-player
items.title: Audio Player
items.description: A clip that plays where it stands: play and pause, its shape to scrub through, and the time.

items.name: mic-menu
items.title: Mic Menu
items.description: Which microphone to use, from the inputs the browser lists, kept current as devices come and go.

items.name: prompt-menu
items.title: Prompt Menu
items.description: A menu of preset instructions to put the assistant under, grouped, with a line on how each changes the answer.

items.name: code-snippet
items.title: Code Snippet
items.description: A command to copy, with tabs for npm, pnpm, yarn and bun.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: Folders and files a change touched, marked added, changed or removed, walked with the arrow keys.

items.name: code-workspace
items.title: Code Workspace
items.description: A read-only editor for a set of files: a resizable file tree, tabs, a quick file picker, and search and replace across names and contents.
items.docs: Replacing never writes to your files. It previews the result in the workspace until it's undone, and what to do with it is up to you.

items.name: sandbox
items.title: Sandbox
items.description: Code that runs in the page with Sandpack, in our own chrome: a live preview with a loading bar and its errors, an editor with a file tree and file tabs, and a console, under one toolbar that follows light and dark.
items.docs: Sandpack bundles and runs the code on CodeSandbox's servers, so the preview needs a network connection. The colours follow a `dark` class on `<html>`.

items.name: web-preview
items.title: Web Preview
items.description: A page in a frame with a browser's chrome: back, forward and reload, an address bar with the connection's details, a console that folds out, an annotate toggle, and a menu with zoom and a phone-width view.
items.docs: Many sites refuse to be framed, so preview pages you serve yourself, or pass `srcDoc`. The console shows the logs you hand it; the framed page has to post them to you.

items.name: run-budget
items.title: Run Budget
items.description: A spend cap for an agent run: pick it, watch the meter fill and warn near the cap, then keep what's done or raise the cap when it stops.

items.name: prompt-autocomplete
items.title: Prompt Autocomplete
items.description: A prompt field that shows a suggested ending as ghost text. Tab takes all of it, Option-Right the next word, and Escape dismisses it.

items.name: human-handoff
items.title: Human Handoff
items.description: Hands a chat to a person: an editable summary of what they'll see, a place in the queue that counts down, then who joined, or a way to be reached when no one is in.

items.name: agent-cursor
items.title: Agent Cursor
items.description: A document you and an agent edit together. The paragraph it's rewriting is marked while the draft streams in beside it, to replace or discard, and editing that paragraph meanwhile offers to keep yours, take the agent's or merge.

items.name: attempt-picker
items.title: Attempt Picker
items.description: Several attempts at one task side by side, with progress while they run, then lines changed, tests passing and a suggested pick, and one to apply while the rest are discarded.

items.name: needs-you
items.title: Needs You
items.description: An inbox of agents waiting on you, oldest first: approvals, questions with choices and blocked tasks, answered in place, with waits that count up and mark themselves overdue.

items.name: reactions
items.title: Reactions
items.description: Emoji counts under a message that you press to add or take back your own.

items.name: message-status
items.title: Message Status
items.description: How far a message has got: sending, sent, delivered, read, or not sent with a retry.

items.name: timestamps
items.title: Timestamps
items.description: When a message was sent, worded by how long ago, beside it or across the thread.

items.name: message-context-menu
items.title: Message Context Menu
items.description: The menu a message opens on right click or long press, with a row of reactions above its actions.

items.name: plan-review
items.title: Plan Review
items.description: The plan an agent proposes, to reorder, rewrite, trim and add to before it runs, or send back with a note. It reports exactly what changed.
items.docs: The receipt fades in with tw-animate-css. Add `@import "tw-animate-css";` to your global stylesheet if it is not there already.

items.name: compaction-marker
items.title: Compaction Marker
items.description: The line in a thread where an agent compacted its context: a sweep while it works, then the tokens before and after, opening to what was kept.
items.docs: The shimmer comes from shadcn/tailwind.css, which `shadcn init` adds to your global stylesheet.

items.name: agent-steps
items.title: Agent Steps
items.description: An agent's run laid out step by step: a row that reads Working while it runs and Worked for 12s after, folding open to each step's status, a line of detail and the results it found.
items.docs: The shimmer comes from shadcn/tailwind.css, which `shadcn init` adds to your global stylesheet.

items.name: agent-card
items.title: Agent Card
items.description: What an agent is: its mark, name and model, the instructions it follows, the tools it can call and the shape of what it returns.

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: Typing Indicator
items.description: Three dots that bounce in turn while someone writes a reply, in a bubble that sits in a thread like a message or bare for a row of your own.

items.name: artifact
items.title: Artifact
items.description: A panel for something a reply made, like a file, a document or a page: a header with its title, a line about it, actions and a close button, over a body that scrolls.

items.name: stack-trace
items.title: Stack Trace
items.description: An error read from its printed trace: the type and message, opening to its frames, with library frames folded away, file paths that open, and the whole trace to copy.

items.name: commit
items.title: Commit
items.description: A commit in one row: its message, author, time and lines changed, with the hash to copy, opening to the files it touched.

items.name: context-breakdown
items.title: Context Breakdown
items.description: What fills a model's context window: one bar split into the system prompt, tools, files and conversation, with a legend of token counts and what's free, sliding as parts grow or are compacted.

items.name: retrieved-sources
items.title: Retrieved Sources
items.description: The passages a reply was built from: each document with where the passage sits and how relevant it scored, opening to the passage, with those under a threshold muted.

items.name: contact-button
items.title: Contact Button
items.description: Who you're talking to, at the top of a chat: their picture over a pill with their name, opening more about them.

items.name: call-menu
items.title: Call Menu
items.description: A small round picture of who you'd call, opening a menu to start a video call or a voice call.

items.name: video-call
items.title: Video Call
items.description: A live call with the assistant: the orb listens and speaks, your camera sits in a corner and is shared with it a frame a second, with mute, camera and hang-up, and a transcript beside it. Runs on Gemini Live, or on a mock with no key.
items.docs: For real calls, add `@aiellie/live-token` and set `GEMINI_API_KEY` on the server. Pass `mock` to try it without one.

items.name: live-call
items.title: Live Call
items.description: The two sides a video call can talk to: Gemini Live over a WebSocket, sending the microphone as PCM and the camera as a JPEG a second, and a mock that plays the assistant with no key or network.

items.name: live-token
items.title: Live Token
items.description: A route that turns the server's Gemini key into a one-use token for the browser, locked to one Live model and its settings, so the key never leaves the server.
